caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-colored metal cauldron set against a plain, light beige background. The cauldron has a cylindrical shape that slightly tapers towards the bottom and features two small metal loops on either side near the rim, which hold a handle made of the same dark metal. The handle arches loosely above the cauldron and is attached at each end to the loops. The surface of the cauldron shows a textured, mottled pattern in various shades of dark brown, rusty orange, and black, giving it an aged and weathered appearance. The cauldron stands on three short legs, and a subtle shadow beneath the object is visible, indicating it is raised slightly above the surface. There is a small signature in the lower right corner, reading "N. Almada."
title: Kettle
